inventory_cost_revaluations_posted_field.name: inventory_cost_revaluations_posted_fields_ck
inventory_cost_revaluations_posted_field.value: "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."status" <> 'POSTED' or ("app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."source_type" is not null and "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."source_id" is not null and "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."amount" is not null and "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."amount" > 0 and "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."currency" is not null and "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."posted_by" is not null and "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."posted_at" is not null and "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."replay_fingerprint" is not null and btrim("app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."replay_fingerprint") <> '')

inventory_cost_revaluations_boundary_ord.name: inventory_cost_revaluations_boundary_order_ck
inventory_cost_revaluations_boundary_ord.value: "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."restatement_through_at" is null or "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."restatement_from_at" is null or "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."restatement_through_at" >= "app"."inventory_cost_revaluations"."restatement_from_at"

inventory_cost_stream_state_valuation_pa.name: inventory_cost_stream_state_valuation_pair_ck
inventory_cost_stream_state_valuation_pa.value: ("app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."valuation_status" = 'UNVALUED' and "app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."inventory_value" is null and "app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."weighted_average_cost" is null and "app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."currency" is null) or ("app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."valuation_status" = 'VALUED' and "app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."inventory_value" is not null and "app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."currency" is not null and btrim("app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."currency") <> '' and ("app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."quantity_litres" = 0 or "app"."inventory_cost_stream_state"."weighted_average_cost" is not null))

inventory_sale_cost_attributions_basis_c.name: inventory_sale_cost_attributions_basis_ck
inventory_sale_cost_attributions_basis_c.value: "app"."inventory_sale_cost_attributions"."valuation_basis" = 'PRE_SALE_WAC' and "app"."inventory_sale_cost_attributions"."pre_sale_wac" is not null and "app"."inventory_sale_cost_attributions"."original_cogs" is not null and "app"."inventory_sale_cost_attributions"."sale_cost_event_id" is not null

fuel_deliveries_cost_pair_chk.name: fuel_deliveries_cost_pair_chk
fuel_deliveries_cost_pair_chk.value: ("app"."fuel_deliveries"."unit_landed_cost" is null and "app"."fuel_deliveries"."total_landed_cost" is null and "app"."fuel_deliveries"."currency" is null) or ("app"."fuel_deliveries"."unit_landed_cost" is not null and "app"."fuel_deliveries"."total_landed_cost" is not null and "app"."fuel_deliveries"."currency" is not null)

inventory_movements_cost_pair_chk.name: inventory_movements_cost_pair_chk
inventory_movements_cost_pair_chk.value: ("app"."inventory_movements"."unit_landed_cost" is null and "app"."inventory_movements"."total_landed_cost" is null and "app"."inventory_movements"."currency" is null) or ("app"."inventory_movements"."unit_landed_cost" is not null and "app"."inventory_movements"."total_landed_cost" is not null and "app"."inventory_movements"."currency" is not null)

tank_dips_raw_measurement_pair_chk.name: tank_dips_raw_measurement_pair_chk
tank_dips_raw_measurement_pair_chk.value: ("app"."tank_dips"."raw_measurement" is null and "app"."tank_dips"."measurement_unit" is null) or ("app"."tank_dips"."raw_measurement" is not null and "app"."tank_dips"."measurement_unit" is not null)

cash_movements_direction_ck.name: cash_movements_direction_ck
cash_movements_direction_ck.value:
(
        ("app"."cash_movements"."movement_type" = 'RECEIPT' and "app"."cash_movements"."from_location_id" is null and "app"."cash_movements"."to_location_id" is not null)
        or ("app"."cash_movements"."movement_type" = 'DISBURSEMENT' and "app"."cash_movements"."from_location_id" is not null and "app"."cash_movements"."to_location_id" is null)
        or ("app"."cash_movements"."movement_type" = 'TRANSFER' and "app"."cash_movements"."from_location_id" is not null and "app"."cash_movements"."to_location_id" is not null and "app"."cash_movements"."from_location_id" <> "app"."cash_movements"."to_location_id")
        or ("app"."cash_movements"."movement_type" = 'ADJUSTMENT_IN' and "app"."cash_movements"."from_location_id" is null and "app"."cash_movements"."to_location_id" is not null)
        or ("app"."cash_movements"."movement_type" = 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT' and "app"."cash_movements"."from_location_id" is not null and "app"."cash_movements"."to_location_id" is null)
      )

supplier_documents_post_provenance_ck.name: supplier_documents_post_provenance_ck
supplier_documents_post_provenance_ck.value: "app"."supplier_documents"."posted_at" is null or "app"."supplier_documents"."posted_by" is not null

supplier_documents_reversal_provenance_c.name: supplier_documents_reversal_provenance_ck
supplier_documents_reversal_provenance_c.value: "app"."supplier_documents"."state" <> 'REVERSED' or ("app"."supplier_documents"."reversed_by" is not null and "app"."supplier_documents"."reversed_at" is not null and btrim(coalesce("app"."supplier_documents"."reversal_reason", '')) <> '')

supplier_payments_post_provenance_ck.name: supplier_payments_post_provenance_ck
supplier_payments_post_provenance_ck.value: "app"."supplier_payments"."posted_at" is null or "app"."supplier_payments"."posted_by" is not null

supplier_payments_reversal_provenance_ck.name: supplier_payments_reversal_provenance_ck
supplier_payments_reversal_provenance_ck.value: "app"."supplier_payments"."state" <> 'REVERSED' or ("app"."supplier_payments"."reversed_by" is not null and "app"."supplier_payments"."reversed_at" is not null and btrim(coalesce("app"."supplier_payments"."reversal_reason", '')) <> '')

customer_ledger_entries_value_shape_ck.name: customer_ledger_entries_value_shape_ck
customer_ledger_entries_value_shape_ck.value:
(
      ("app"."customer_ledger_entries"."account_type" in ('CREDIT','PREPAID_VALUE') and "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."amount" > 0 and "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."quantity_litres" is null and ("app"."customer_ledger_entries"."product_id" is null or "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."account_type" = 'CREDIT'))
      or ("app"."customer_ledger_entries"."account_type" = 'PREPAID_LITRES' and "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."amount" is null and "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."quantity_litres" > 0 and "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."product_id" is not null)
    )

customer_ledger_entries_entry_account_ck.name: customer_ledger_entries_entry_account_ck
customer_ledger_entries_entry_account_ck.value:
(
      ("app"."customer_ledger_entries"."account_type" = 'CREDIT' and "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."entry_type" in ('CREDIT_FUEL_CHARGE','CUSTOMER_PAYMENT','ADJUSTMENT','REVERSAL'))
      or ("app"."customer_ledger_entries"."account_type" = 'PREPAID_VALUE' and "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."entry_type" in ('PREPAID_TOPUP','PREPAID_FUEL_USAGE','ADJUSTMENT','REVERSAL'))
      or ("app"."customer_ledger_entries"."account_type" = 'PREPAID_LITRES' and "app"."customer_ledger_entries"."entry_type" in ('PREPAID_TOPUP','PREPAID_FUEL_USAGE','ADJUSTMENT','REVERSAL'))
    )

provider_settlement_allocations_reversal.name: provider_settlement_allocations_reversal_ck
provider_settlement_allocations_reversal.value: ("app"."provider_settlement_allocations"."state" = 'POSTED' and "app"."provider_settlement_allocations"."reversal_of_id" is null) or ("app"."provider_settlement_allocations"."state" = 'REVERSED' and "app"."provider_settlement_allocations"."reversal_of_id" is not null)
